# Telegram release pilot – Strážca Termínov

Default: preview only, no network request to Telegram. The existing Pages deployment is completed before the notification job. Only the Slovak storefront of App Store ID 6779741336 is eligible; initial baseline 1.61.0 (2026-10-08). The message is app name + version + blank line + original releaseNotes, no generated content, no links or screenshots. Only the latest observed release is considered; this is not a historical backfill. Missing notes, rollback, unknown version, oversized text, or mismatched app ID stop publication.

Use a separate publication bot, never the private error-reporting bot. Store credentials in GitHub Actions Secrets: TELEGRAM_RELEASE_BOT_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_TEST_CHAT_ID (numeric private destination), TELEGRAM_RELEASE_CHAT_ID (production channel). Do not put tokens or chat IDs in files or logs. Set ENABLE_TELEGRAM_PRIVATE_TEST=true only for the separate manual Telegram private test workflow; disable after testing. Production remains disabled until explicit approval and ENABLE_TELEGRAM_RELEASES=true. Grant the bot permission to post in the intended channel. Never use the public channel as a test destination.

State is .github/telegram-release-state.json. A reservation must be committed and pushed before the API call. After a confirmed send, the version/date are committed as last and pending is cleared. A failed or ambiguous send or failed confirmation leaves pending durably reserved, so automatic retry is blocked. This deliberately favors no duplicates over guaranteed delivery. Inspect the actual channel before resolving a pending record: if present, copy pending to last and set pending null; if definitely absent, clear pending while retaining last. Use an audited commit, never reset blindly. Git push conflicts fail safely. No delivery status changes in preview/private test. Telegram failure does not roll back the already deployed website.

CI tests are offline; the marked private test is the only live test before activation. No public message should be sent until activation is approved. Future apps require explicit allowlist and independent baseline/state entries; adapt baseline validation per app at that time.
